subject: Re: URGENT - ZenithCare private VPC: elevated error rate & latency
messages:
From: Rajiv Mehta <rajiv@zenithcare.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@zenithcare.com
Date: 2027-10-09T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: URGENT: Production errors and 5-10s latencies on private cluster

Hi Lauren,

We are seeing a sudden spike in 500s and request latency on our private VPC deployment since ~07:45 PT. Error rate (5xx) has climbed to ~8% and p95 latency is 5-10s (was ~600ms). This is impacting our triage workflows and blocking scheduled overnight batch runs.

Attached a small packet of recent logs and a heap of sample request traces (support_request_zenith_1010.zip). Can someone from Redwood triage immediately? We need a mitigation plan and ETA. We are on a tight regulatory timeline and this is customer-impacting.

- Rajiv
Head of Platform | ZenithCare
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Mehta <rajiv@zenithcare.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-09T08:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Production errors and 5-10s latencies on private cluster

Rajiv — thanks for the quick heads up and the logs. I’m escalating this to SRE and ENG immediately and we’ll stand up a war room.

Immediate asks and actions I plan to take now:
- Rishi/Vivek: please start triage and post a short triage summary to the war room within 15 min.
- Marissa: I’ll coordinate customer comms and procurement touchpoints.
- Hannah: please be on-call for any rollback/rollback risk decisions.

Potential quick mitigations (we can do now if you approve):
- Temporarily increase dedicated GPU pool by +4 nodes (if capacity available).
- Enable the quantized fallback variant we validated last quarter.
- Turn on aggressive prefix/KV caching for ZenithCare routes.

If you’re available, proposing an executive 15-min sync at 3:00 PM PT today to brief your leadership and ours. ETA depends on triage but we’ll aim for a mitigation in the next 60–90 minutes.

I’ll follow up in the war room with a triage link and the SRE plan.

— Lauren
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rajiv Mehta <rajiv@zenithcare.com>
Date: 2027-10-09T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Production errors and 5-10s latencies on private cluster

Quick triage (observed within Redwood control plane + customer logs):
- Error profile: ~70% of 5xx are OOMs from the decoder worker (GPU process), remainder are 502 gateway timeouts during KV cache rehydration.
- Latency: p95 decode spikes align with large prompt sizes and cache-miss patterns.
- Recent change: no customer-side config change per the audit, but we did roll a model optimizer build to the pool for this account ~2 days ago.

Recommended immediate mitigations (low-risk first):
1) Add 4 GPUs to ZenithCare pool (temp scale). This should reduce concurrency pressure and OOM frequency.
2) Activate the pre-validated quantized fallback variant (q4_2) for their route — smaller memory footprint.
3) Reduce max concurrency per GPU for this customer's pool from 12 -> 6 and set target batch size to 8.
4) Enable prefix/KV caching with a warming period (we can prototype immediate cache seeding for top routes).
5) If problems persist after 30-45 mins, schedule a rolling restart of model workers (staggered to keep some capacity).

I need permission to perform steps 1-3 now; step 4 will require a short config push and monitoring window. Attaching a concise runbook excerpt (sre_runbook_zenith.md) and will paste commands in the war room.

— Rishi
Sr. Escalations Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rajiv Mehta <rajiv@zenithcare.com>
Date: 2027-10-09T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Production errors and 5-10s latencies on private cluster

I’ve reviewed control-plane metrics and network topology (zenith_network_topology.pdf). Notes:
- There is intermittent packet loss on one of their peered links (us-west-2 border) — this would exacerbate KV cache miss and increase gateway timeouts.
- We have capacity in the regional ded pool; I’ll queue the +4 GPUs and coordinate with infra to avoid a simultaneous maintenance window.

Runbook excerpt (high-level):
1) Temporarily scale pool: infra-scale --account zenithcare --add-gpus 4 --region us-west-2
2) Route opt-in: ctl route update zenithcare --model-variant q4_2 --kv-cache enabled --batch-size 8
3) Monitor p95 and 5xx in 10-min windows; if error-rate reduction <50% after 45 mins -> escalate to rolling restart and increase logging level.

I’ll start step 1 now; Rishi please confirm when you push the variant so we can coordinate rollout. Note: scaling will increase cost temporarily; we should capture approvals for any credits if this becomes prolonged.

— Vivek
SRE Lead | Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Mehta <rajiv@zenithcare.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-09T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Exec brief & 15-min sync at 3:00 PM PT

Rajiv — quick update for your execs and ours:
- Root cause hypothesis: combination of decoder OOMs (model memory pressure) + intermittent peering packet loss causing cache thrash.
- Immediate actions: temporary scale + quantized fallback + batch/concurrency tuning + enable KV caching.
- Risk: scaling/variant rollouts carry small risk of transient 502s during warmup; rolling restart only if needed.
- Business ask: if this persists beyond 2 hours we should discuss temporary usage credit and a short SLA exception while we stabilize.

Please confirm the 3:00 PM PT exec sync (15 min) or propose an alternate time. Our engineering leads will join.

— Lauren
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: Rajiv Mehta <rajiv@zenithcare.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-10T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Production errors and 5-10s latencies on private cluster

Team — thanks for the fast response. After your changes yesterday the error rate dropped to ~0.6% and p95 is back to ~700ms. The peering team applied a filter that reduced packet loss and your scaling/variant swap looked to absorb the peak.

We still see sporadic single-digit 5xx occurrences during large prompt paths; will validate if those are residual traces. For now the customer impact is resolved and I appreciate the quick coordination.

Please send a short postmortem and any follow-up mitigations (longer-term: KV cache sizing and peering circuit redundancy). Also cc procurement on any credit discussions.

— Rajiv
Head of Platform | ZenithCare
